entries.title: Galatians 5:1
segments: ¶Stand fast therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and do not be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

entries.title: Galatians 5:2
segments: Indeed I, Paul, say to you that if you become circumcised, Christ will profit you nothing.

entries.title: Galatians 5:3
segments: And I testify again to every man who becomes circumcised that he is a debtor to keep the whole law.

entries.title: Galatians 5:4
segments: You have become estranged from Christ, you who [attempt to] be justified by law; you have fallen from grace.

entries.title: Galatians 5:5
segments: For we through the Spirit eagerly wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.

entries.title: Galatians 5:6
segments: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision avails anything, but faith working through love.

entries.title: Galatians 5:7
segments: You ran well. Who hindered you from obeying the truth?

entries.title: Galatians 5:8
segments: This persuasion does not [come] from Him who calls you.

entries.title: Galatians 5:9
segments: A little leaven leavens the whole lump.

entries.title: Galatians 5:10
segments: I have confidence in you, in the Lord, that you will have no other mind; but he who troubles you shall bear his judgment, whoever he is.

entries.title: Galatians 5:11
segments: And I, brethren, if I still preach circumcision, why do I still suffer persecution? Then the offense of the cross has ceased.

entries.title: Galatians 5:12
segments: I could wish that those who trouble you would even cut themselves off!

entries.title: Galatians 5:13
segments: ¶For you, brethren, have been called to liberty; only do not [use] liberty as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love serve one another.

entries.title: Galatians 5:14
segments: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, [even] in this: "You shall love your neighbor as yourself."

entries.title: Galatians 5:15
segments: But if you bite and devour one another, beware lest you be consumed by one another!

entries.title: Galatians 5:16
segments: I say then: Walk in the Spirit, and you shall not fulfill the lust of the flesh.

entries.title: Galatians 5:17
segments: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, so that you do not do the things that you wish.

entries.title: Galatians 5:18
segments: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

entries.title: Galatians 5:19
segments: Now the works of the flesh are evident, which are: adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lewdness,

entries.title: Galatians 5:20
segments: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, contentions, jealousies, outbursts of wrath, selfish ambitions, dissensions, heresies,

entries.title: Galatians 5:21
segments: envy, murders, drunkenness, revelries, and the like; of which I tell you beforehand, just as I also told [you] in time past, that those who practice such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.

entries.title: Galatians 5:22
segments: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,

entries.title: Galatians 5:23
segments: gentleness, self-control. Against such there is no law.

entries.title: Galatians 5:24
segments: And those [who are] Christ's have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.

entries.title: Galatians 5:25
segments: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.

entries.title: Galatians 5:26
segments: Let us not become conceited, provoking one another, envying one another.
